purpose: Teach: 借地/集成/私有/兼業/満了/抹消/協約/家主

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、駐在所の借地契約を更新されたんですね
lines.en: I see the police station renewed the lease on their premises.
lines.style: Warm, conversational opening. Genuinely interested tone, not interrogatory. Slight upward lilt on the statement, like he's confirming what he's learned. Easy pacing, attentive posture.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、犯罪事例を集成した報告書を発行されますね
lines.en: And you publish comprehensive reports that compile crime case data, don't you.
lines.style: Continuing in the same thoughtful vein. Admiring note creeping in — recognition of thoroughness. Steady rhythm. Small pause before the tag-question, like he's thinking through what he knows.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、私有地での違法行為を捜査されますね
lines.en: You also investigate illegal activity on private land.
lines.style: Factual, no challenge underneath. Affirming nod in the voice. Slightly slower pace — this is important work. Respectful clarity, like he's setting the record straight for understanding.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、警察官の兼業規制について研修されますね
lines.en: I imagine you run training on regulations around officers having side employment.
lines.style: Thoughtful, inferential. Not stating as fact but as reasonable assumption. Careful tone — he's being considerate about asking. Gentle pacing, genuine interest in their operational rigor.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、保護観察の満了についても市民にご説明されますね
lines.en: And you explain probation completion status to the community as well.
lines.style: Appreciative recognition. Warmer now — he's acknowledging community-facing work. Smooth continuity in the rhythm. Small emphasis on 'community', like he's noting the care involved.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、犯歴の抹消手続きには厳格な規則を設けていらっしゃいますね
lines.en: You maintain strict procedures for criminal record expungement, I gather.
lines.style: Respectful formality. Light emphasis on 'strict' — admiring the principled approach. Steady, almost measured pace. The tone of someone recognizing institutional integrity.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、地域協約への加入もご検討中ですね
lines.en: You're even considering joining local civic agreements.
lines.style: Genuine warmth breaking through. Slight uptick in brightness. Collaborative spirit in the delivery. Lean-in energy — he's pleased by this sign of engagement with the community.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、家主との家賃トラブル仲裁もされますね
lines.en: You help mediate landlord-tenant disputes over rent too, don't you.
lines.style: Closer now, slightly more personal. Warmth and familiarity. Recognizing the human dimension of police work. Gentle curiosity, like he's impressed by the breadth of what they do. Conversational ease.
